overall_reason: A hand-written token system (129 own tokens: colour, shadow, radius, spacing and layer roles) runs the page with 97% of colour, radius and shadow declarations via var(); the drift is font sizes typed as literals that equal tokens, and layers outside the one z-index token.

score.reason: T-HARDCODE passes for colour, radius and shadow but fails for 12 font-size literals that retype tokens (TOK-006); T-LADDER finds layers beside --z-nav (TOK-005); the hero fan of product cards is treated as an exhibit.

findings.evidence: declarations.literal_retypes_a_token_value.font_size lists 12 rules whose literal equals a declared token: .brand 24px, .install 15px, .how__step h3 17px, .faq summary 17px, .how__art--lint 12px, .th-dlg__name 32px. Font-size declarations are 37% literal against 97% var for colour and radius.
findings.before: Type sizes retyped where tokens exist
findings.after: Those rules read the type tokens
findings.why: A change to the type scale would miss the retyped headings and labels.

findings.evidence: values.1440.z_index has 13 values (-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 30, 50, 100); the token set has one layer token, --z-nav. The 12 to 18 steps stack the fan cards on purpose.
findings.before: One named layer and the rest typed per rule
findings.after: A named ladder for nav, dialog and toast beside the fan's local stacking
findings.why: Unnamed layers above the fan risk collisions as overlays are added.

findings.where: section subtitles, headings, install line; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size.near_duplicates chain 14.5/15, 15/16 and 16/17: 15px on .install and the GitHub label, 16px on the skip link, 17px on head__sub and step h3. Durations run 650, 700, 720 and 760ms.
findings.before: Body-range sizes and long durations a step apart
findings.after: Merge 14.5 into 15 and keep 15 and 17 as the two body steps; one long duration

strengths: Shadows are 100% var (--shadow-card and friends), radius 97% var, colour 97% var.
Spacing is a numbered scale (--s-1 to --s-10) used by 94% of spacing declarations.
not_investigated: The hero fan of product screenshots and phone frames is an exhibit (the 13.5px and 10.5px radii and the near-duplicate dark fills #1c1c1a and #1e1f21 sit on those cards); not judged as the page's components.
T-THEME-PARITY: no second theme in the readable CSS.
T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: no framework fingerprint beyond one class name.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a design-skill product page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
